there is being pro ai, and there is being pro low effort, they are not the same.

I dont think its appropriate to shit on anyone, positive reinforcement is superior and builds stronger communities, but these are just not the same thing.

There are literally tens of thousands of absolutely dog shit games out there. Its not an exaggerated statement.  people will be negative about it. you cant stop that.

Don't conflate someone criticizing a bad game design effort with them being anti ai.


Recently I've built a lot of games, I have spent time working on games for decades.

Ai has made it so ive produced about 6 games this year, increasing the number of games I've produced over 2 decades by 700%

you know what I learned?

That while I'm quote a skilled programmer, and I have a good eye for anesthetics, im actually dogshit at game design.
